problem_type: Existing identifiers on unchanged historical claims are mistaken for new identifiers when only a docs reference is relocated
symptom: Archive path updates in existing reports, contracts and source comments trigger the private-ID guard for identifiers already in the trusted base line.
direct_cause: Git diff marks a reference-only line replacement as an added line; copy/rename inheritance does not apply to same-file reference changes.
class_root: Identifier authorship is classified by a line addition without checking an exact trusted-base claim whose only change is an archive path insertion.
affected_population: existing schema-v3 contract prose reference edits
entry_points: explicit-file scan remains whole-file and unchanged

external_sources.purpose: Git -C/-M describe copy/rename provenance and corresponding patch headers.

invariants: New identifiers and newly authored claims remain blocked.
Only a full existing base line whose sole change is a canonical docs/archive path insertion inherits its old identifier.
Whole-file credential scanning and explicit-file strictness remain unchanged.
generality_proof: Both staged and committed scans use gitDiffAdded. Only exact base lines transformed solely by canonical docs/archive insertion inherit their existing ID. Identifier changes, other claim edits and credentials remain violations. No archive directory or caller manifest exempts any file.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Return authored diff identifiers after verifying copy/rename provenance against the trusted base document.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Runs the shared diff reader against HEAD plus staged changes.
Runs the same reader against explicit trusted base or the PR merge-base and HEAD.
Explicit whole-file scans do not claim Git provenance and retain their strict whole-file behavior.

recurrence.reason: Every existing claim with an inherited identifier and a relocated reference can repeat the issue.
same_class_scan: gitDiffAdded --roots=scripts --include-tests:494 files,one shared write door and both staged/all callers.
Existing archival reports,v3 contract prose and source comments reproduced the same diff-line false positive.
Real Git regression RED:1 failed and35 passed before extending same-file line provenance.

prevention.invariant: All staged and CI private-ID checks use actual copy/rename provenance before distinguishing inherited from authored IDs.
prevention.failure_mode: Unproven source provenance inherits nothing. New identifiers remain violations and full-file credential rules are unchanged.
prevention.strategy: Generate only canonical archive insertions from trusted same-file base lines; accept inheritance only on exact transformed line equality. ID and all other text must be identical.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace AM-only/no-provenance classification in both staged and CI branches; do not add a parallel archive bypass.

dependency_lifecycle.current: Git2.55.0 and existing Node child_process execution
dependency_lifecycle.target: Retain the repository Git CLI with standard copy/rename patch metadata; no new dependency.
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Git already owns document provenance. Upgrade of the runtime is not required for these established flags.
exit_criteria: Before a Git runtime upgrade, rerun real staged and --all copy/rename plus credential regressions in scripts/check-no-secrets.test.mjs.
If copy detection cannot establish provenance, inherit no identifiers and require a normal reviewed document change.

migration: Keep credential whole-file scanning and existing copy/rename behavior. Compare exact previous claim text after only canonical archive reference insertion; remove only the already-present IDs for that proven line.
residual_risks: Noncanonical reference transformations receive no inheritance and remain conservatively blocked.
